name: FeuerWerk HolzErlebnisWelt Fügen
kurzbeschreibung: FeuerWerk in Fügen in the Zillertal: Europe's most modern BioMasseHeizKraftWerk by the Binderholz Group featuring HolzErlebnisWelt, a sculpture garden, and roof terrace.
beschreibung:
Overview

The architecturally fascinating FeuerWerk HolzErlebnisWelt is located in the lower Zillertal in the market town of Fügen (Schwaz district) at an altitude of around 545 metres. Built on the factory premises of the globally operating Binderholz Group, this monumental industrial and cultural site combines one of Europe's most advanced and economical biomass cogeneration plants (BioMasseHeizKraftWerke Europas) with a pioneering educational and cultural centre. Honoured with multiple renowned architecture and timber construction awards, the building impressively demonstrates how sustainable forestry, state-of-the-art sawmill technology, green power generation, and contemporary art merge in harmony.

Power Plant Guided Tour & Timber Architecture

FeuerWerk was constructed using cutting-edge cross-laminated timber and solid wood elements, showcasing the versatile architectural potential of wood as a renewable resource. On an engaging, multimedia-guided tour with an audio guide, visitors gaze through massive panoramic windows directly into the heart of energy production: observing the arrival of sawmill by-products such as bark and wood chips, the drying process, the highly efficient combustion in colossal biomass boilers, and the generation of green electricity and district heating for the entire region. Clear display panels and interactive stations illustrate the global carbon cycle and timber's vital contribution to active climate protection. The cultural pinnacle on the top floor is the SichtBAR cultural space, which hosts rotating art exhibitions, concerts, and literary readings by international artists throughout the year. Adjoining is an expansive roof terrace with the Garden of the Skies (Garten der Lüfte) at a height of 16 metres: amidst fragrant Swiss stone pines and contemporary sculptures, sweeping views open across the valley of the Zillertaler Alpen.

Visit & Getting There

The FeuerWerk HolzErlebnisWelt and the SichtBAR restaurant are open year-round from Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 16:00 (closed on Sundays). The power plant tour lasts approximately one hour (last admission for the tour at 15:00). Admission prices (as of the 2025/2026 season): guided tour adults approx. €11.00, seniors approx. €9.50, children and youths (aged 6 to 15) approx. €6.00, children under 6 free; family ticket approx. €26.00. Holders of the Zillertal Activcard receive a discount. The sculpture garden and the SichtBAR panoramic restaurant are freely accessible. Arrival by car: via the Inntalautobahn A12 (exit Wiesing/Zillertal), follow the B169 for about ten kilometres into the valley to the Fügen Nord exit, then follow the signage to the Binderholz complex (free parking at Zillertalstraße 39). By public transport: take the Zillertalbahn railway to Bahnhof Fügen-Hart, from where it is roughly a five-minute walk directly to FeuerWerk.

Tips

The entire FeuerWerk building, tour levels, and roof terrace are fully step-free and wheelchair-accessible thanks to modern spacious elevators. Stop by the SichtBAR restaurant on the top floor to enjoy regional Tyrolean specialties and homemade pastries while taking in panoramic views of the Zillertal. The tour is completely weather-independent, making it an ideal excursion choice on rainy days.
